statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); current_dir=$(basename "$cwd"); git_info=""; if git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git -C "$cwd" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ]; then if git -C "$cwd" diff-index --quiet HEAD -- 2>/dev/null; then git_info=" git:($branch)"; else git_info=" git:($branch) ✗"; fi; fi; fi; used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); context_info=""; if [ -n "$used" ]; then context_info=$(printf " \033[33m[ctx: %.0f%%]\033[0m" "$used"); fi; printf "\033[1;32m➜\033[0m  \033[36m%s\033[0m%s%s" "$current_dir" "$git_info" "$context_info"
